resources.string: Interactive in-memory prototype for vegetable vendor inventory. No database storage yet.
Functional requirements covered in this screen:

• Batch (lot) creation fields
• Automatic landed cost calculation
• Dynamic spoilage / waste logging
• True cost per kilo recalculation
• Sack / crate to kilogram conversion

• ProcurementBatch
• SpoilageEntry
• MeasuredWholesaleUnits
• UnitConversion
• LandedCostCalculator
• TrueCostPerKiloEngine
